name: question
description:
Ask the human user one or more questions and wait for their answers. This is the only tool that opens a direct channel to the user for live dialogue.

Use question whenever you need direct input from the human user — regardless of whether
you are in a delegated session or not.

Use question for:
1. Gathering user preferences or requirements
2. Clarifying ambiguous instructions
3. Getting decisions on implementation choices
4. Offering choices about direction

This applies even when you are in a delegated session with a reply_to contract. If you
need the user's answer to proceed, use question — not reply. reply cannot carry the
user's response back to you; question can.

Usage notes:
- A "Type your own answer" option is added automatically; don't include "Other" or catch-all options
- Answers are returned as arrays of labels
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label

question.description: The question text to display to the user

header.description: Optional header label shown above the question

options.description: Optional list of choices. If omitted, user types a free-form answer.

label.description: The choice label shown to the user

description.description: Optional description shown beneath the label
